findings.finding_text: L9 default (mock) writes arm:jev records into the top-level triage corpus that ab-report counts as measured jev data
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: route mock-mode L9 records to corpus/mock like L8

findings.finding_text: Resident reply {action:compact} is now accepted+counted (pre-J4: rejected with gate_bypass_attempt) — recording-only claim false in-box
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: solicit() refuses compact by ORIGIN (resident replies) with the existing tripwire; schema member + POINT_ALLOWLIST stay (AC2) and govern the future host path; export a pure allowedAt predicate for the allowlist tests

findings.finding_text: L7 almost never fires mid-run: journal resident block written only pre-walk + post-run_end; RSS/context null
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: engine-side mid-run resident refresh is box-side work outside J4 Files-to-Modify; honest-unproven limb recorded in story + DD register; L7 additionally gated to live resident status (R1-09)

findings.finding_text: onTick timeout orphans the L7 ask which keeps the corpus lock; later residents fail misattributed as judge-failed
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: L7 ask bounded below ON_TICK_DEADLINE (client timeout / own deadline), lock released in finally, RunLockedError mapped to corpus-locked

findings.finding_text: Hook time can exhaust the sweep wall-clock budget and starve later (settled) candidates
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: observe: skip onTick when remaining pass budget < hook deadline (logged), so hooks never push the sweep past its budget

findings.finding_text: Production hook writes cwd-relative _bmad-output/judgment into whatever repo fleet runs from
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: anchor default pack dirs to the factory repo root (module-relative), not cwd

findings.finding_text: Armed L8 drops every finding when the corpus lock fails; kept-set keyed by findingId alone collides across runs
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: misses are never filtered; key runId+findingId

findings.finding_text: L7 idempotence key uses the sweep UUID: unchanged state re-asked every sweep; single ever-growing file read twice per ask
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: per-tick key kept (story: runId+tick) but skip the ask when the run's last recorded state digest is unchanged; shard machine-state corpus per runId; torn line = corpus-unreadable miss

findings.finding_text: L7 asks about stopped/degraded residents
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: ask only while resident status is live/running

findings.finding_text: L7 thresholds use default ceilings not per-run manifest values
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: story pins spend vs 8_000 µ$ and iterations vs 3 (thresholds-in-code, LOCKED); the host has no per-run manifest bound in the RunRecord; recorded as a known ceiling in the module header

findings.finding_text: No production steering-writer path; arming would only log a miss
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: story: the in-box applier + host path are unowned follow-up of the arming PR (DD-28.26); recorded in the register line

findings.finding_text: Sanity leg never invoked; manifest_consistent question invented without register entry
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: register line names the provisional question (no disposition values); story wiring = callable chain (Files to Modify lists no dispatch edit); recorded in Dev Agent Record

findings.finding_text: L9 re-asks (paid) hotspots whose records then dedupe away
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: check existing record (key incl. brief digest) before asking

findings.finding_text: Machine-state validator ignores object keys (prose smuggled in keys)
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: validate keys against the id regex too

findings.finding_text: L9-less tree check (DoD) not exercised in tests/CI
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: cut-boundary test materialises an L9-less copy and runs the pack suite there

findings.finding_text: fleet observe --all wiring untested; FleetDeps.judgmentPack unexercised
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: test runs the CLI sweep path with an injected judgmentPack and asserts the hook fired

findings.finding_text: appendRecord accepts machine-state records into any dir (one misrouted line breaks ab-report)
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: appendRecord back to triage-only (byte-identical behavior to dev); new appendMachineStateRecord sharing the internals

findings.finding_text: Unarmed hook adds two box reads per unsettled run per sweep
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: bounded by DEFAULT_PER_CALL_DEADLINE_MS and needed to record (LOCKED #5 records while unarmed); documented

findings.finding_text: Some unreadable journal states return silently instead of a miss
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: log a miss for probe failure / invalid resident block

findings.finding_text: L9 ids collide past 300 chars; NaN/Infinity scores accepted
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: digest-suffixed ids; reject non-finite scores

findings.finding_text: opensrc walk 'bounded' comment false; walks node_modules; one broken symlink fails the package
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: bounded entry count, skip node_modules, lstat/skip symlinks

findings.finding_text: Live ask in flight at CLI exit is paid but unrecorded
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: CLI path is mock-only (no live flag); provenance is emitted inside judge before return; documented

findings.finding_text: Register entry omits that observe.ts also moves deriveBuildId
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: amend the DD line

findings.finding_text: Missing named negative controls: noul-vs-choice arithmetic; hard cap
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: add tests

findings.finding_text: AC1 fence follows relative imports only
